ayahs.transliteration: innā hadaynāhu l-sabīla immā shākiran wa-immā kafūran
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি তাকে পথ দেখিয়ে দিয়েছি, হয় সে কৃতজ্ঞ হবে, না হয় সে অকৃতজ্ঞ হবে।

english_translations.sahih_international: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
english_translations.pickthall: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: But ye will not, except as Allah wills; for Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.
english_translations.shakir: And you do not please except that Allah please, surely Allah is Knowing, Wise;
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (The virtuous mentioned in this chapter) want only what God wants. God is All-knowing and All-wise.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: But you cannot will, unless Allah wills. Verily, Allah is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.
english_translations.arberry: But you will not unless God wills; surely God is ever All-knowing, All-wise.

english_translations.sahih_international: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
english_translations.pickthall: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will; But the wrong-doers,- for them has He prepared a grievous Penalty.
english_translations.shakir: He makes whom He pleases to enter into His mercy; and (as for) the unjust, He has prepared for them a painful chastisement.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: He admits to His mercy whomever He wants. For the unjust He has prepared a painful punishment.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will and as for the Zalimun, (polytheists, wrong-doers, etc.) He has prepared a painful torment.
english_translations.arberry: For He admits into His mercy whomsoever He will; as for the evildoers, He has prepared for them a painful chastisement.
